instruction: Cinematic portrait, full shot of two men posing next to a boxing ring. On the left, the Black man with braided hair in a white t-shirt (R2) stands leaning against a black ring post, wearing black shorts and black sneakers. On the right, the tattooed white man in a black sleeveless shirt (R1) sits on the edge of the ring apron, wearing black shorts and white sneakers. Both men look directly at the camera with serious expressions. The background features a brick wall, wooden floor, and warm gym lighting.
